description: Check whether a session started with design_session is ready. It waits up to 45 seconds by itself and answers as soon as the design is done, so call it again right away when it says it is still designing. when ready it returns the BRANDED HTML SESSION BRIEF — render it as an artifact. Free (no credits).

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the design before answering (0-45, default 45). Leave it out.

name: design_status
title: Design status
